findings.message: The proposed recipe (rocks/new/rockcraft.yaml) removes the 'demo-info' service that was present in the prior recipe (rocks/old/rockcraft.yaml). Per code-review §3, a source bump that drops a services: entry is a blocker and requires either restoration or explicit PR-author confirmation that the removal is intentional. No confirmation is present in the PR discussion.

summary: Directory reference changed from rocks/old to rocks/new at the same commit (0000000000000000000000000000000000000008). Proposed recipe removes the demo-info service (disabled on-demand informational endpoint). No other parts, packages, version, track or repository changes.
